answer: To keep one operator from flooding the market with clones, every new agent must present a fresh proof-of-work ticket. The network broadcasts a pulse that rotates the puzzle seed every few minutes, so stockpiled hashes expire. Solving it binds an anchor credential to that agent and seats it as a single vertex in the trading graph. Spawning a thousand sybils means paying the full compute cost a thousand times, while an honest agent pays only once per identity.
